verdict.rationale: Reviewing a project's public CVE or security-advisory history is a fair question for an open-source UI framework like Svelte, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a security policy, a GitHub security advisories page, CVE disclosures or a vulnerability-handling process. The GitHub items cover only the compiler description, the roadmap and Discord.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review the project's public CVE/security-advisory history to judge its track record of handling and disclosing vulnerabilities
